main_text.head: DE RATIONE CONTEXENDARVM EPISTOLARVM Pars III.

head.i: Iudicialis generis: & primò Accusatorias, seu Expostulatorias Epistolas continens.

main_text.p: INDICATIS breviter iis, quæ in deliberatiui atq; demonstratiui generis consideranda epistolis videntur, ordo requirit, de illis ut agatur, quæ ad iudiciale genus referuntur: cuiusmodi sunt accusatoriæ, seu expostulatoriæ, querulæ, minatoriæ, exprobratoriæ: & quæ ad eafdē responsiones instituuntur. Nam & harum vsus esse magnus solet: cùm, aut alios accusamus: aut ingratis beneficiorum exprobramus obliuionē: aut de in-digna

page.notes: The large initial "I" is a decorative woodcut letter, joined to "NDICATIS". The word "eafdē" has a tilde over the e. "obliuionē" has a tilde over the final e. The long s is printed as s and has been normalised to s. The text runs on to the next page at the right ("digna" is the continuation of "indigna").
